name: imagination
quote: She drew a horse with feathers.
description: Ability to create a mental object that was previously not experienced.

commentaries.quote: Imagination is sometimes thought of as a fun kid thing, but it's a critical part of many careers. For example, creativity in engineering and design drives those markets.
We must enjoy experiencing imagined things because we do it a lot.

Imagination may feel instantaneous but it's not. Here's how it works: (1) desire to mentally experience something that solves certain constraints. (2) let your sub-conscious focus on those constraints. It will come up with something. (3) Consider the results and refine the constraints as needed. For example: draw a creature that will make my kid smile. She likes dogs. A flying dog could be fun. But she also likes frogs and a flying frog would be even sillier.

conditions: A desire to create a mental experience with certain constraints.
